verify_cmd: node -e "const p=require('./registry/policies/allow-all-pack.json');const bad=p.permissions.filter(function(r){return r.effect!=='allow'});if(bad.length>0)throw new Error('non-allow effect present');console.log('allow-all-pack: all effects are allow')"
when_to_use: Use when the owner global allow-all permission pack must be installed or audited for deny or ask drift. Back up the existing ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json first — the install command overwrites it.
